verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਦਾ ਅਧੀਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਦੁਖਿਤ ਦੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਕੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aapadhaa adheen jaise dhukhit dhuhaagan ko sahaj suhaag na suhaagan ko bhaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a distressed, divorced woman cannot bear to see or tolerate the loving and happy union of another woman with her husband,

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਿਰਹਨੀ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਮੈ ਸੰਜੋਗਨਿ ਕੋ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਅਧਿਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: birahanee bireh biog mai sa(n)jogan ko su(n)dhar si(n)gaar adhikaar na suhaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a woman separated from her husband and bearing the pangs of separation cannot tolerate the embellishments of another woman who is united with her husband,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਨ ਮਾਂਝਿ ਬਾਂਝਿ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਸੋ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਉਤ ਕੋ ਸੁਤਹਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਹਾਂ ਦੁਖ ਪਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tan maa(n)jh baa(n)jh rog sog sa(n)so sram saut ko suteh pekh mahaa(n) dhukh paaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a distressed and fatigued woman suffering from her inability to bear a child feels much distressed on seeing the son of her co-wife,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਦੂਖਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਦੋਖ ਮਮ ਸਾਧਨ ਕੋ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਿਤਾਵਈ ॥੫੧੩॥
verses.translit_en: taise par tan dhan dhookhan tiradhokh mam saadhan ko sukirat na hiradhai hitaaviee ||513||

en.bdb: Similarly I am infested with three chronic ailments-namely other's women, other's wealth and slander. And that is why praise of the devoted and loving Sikhs of the True Guru does not please me.  (513)
